items: 24 miniature Reese's peanut butter cups, unwrapped
Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch pan with cooking spray and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat until mixed in.
Add flour, cocoa, and salt, and mix until well combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan and spread evenly. Arrange peanut butter cups over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Let cool completely.
